description: Proposal admission, single-active leases with expiry and reclaim, fixed budgets, isolated roots with exact-path cleanup, fixture correctness runner with exact outputs, and idempotent exact-revert transactions.

implementation.seam: shared state seam extended with wcncp_leases plus pure coordinator package

coverage: admission allows only actionable material corrections with complete bindings and budget
concurrent claims yield one winner with held errors for losers
heartbeats extend only the same holder
stale holders, late results, and conflicting digests fail closed
remote validation publication requires the exact active lease and holder
expiry is visible and requeueable with reclaim by a new holder
budget stops new work without touching unrelated files or processes
isolated roots never resolve outside the experiment root on cleanup
patch transactions reject drift, postimage mismatch, and symlink escape while preserving file mode
five-start fixture correctness compares every output byte-for-byte and reports actual starts and product failures
